author: theplax
title: Freesound - Clumber Street.wav by theplax
description: Nottingham's Clumber Street is often cited as the busiest pedestrianised shopping street in Europe. This is a recording of ambience from the street on a mid-November weekday evening with a considerable amount of footfall as the street's notorious footwear stores are open. Sound of footsteps, carrier bags, distant traffic noise, passing tram nearby and a variety of languages that reflect the ethnic diversity of Nottingham as a city. Recorded with Voice Recorder Pro on Samsung Galaxy S8 smartphone and edited in Adobe Audition.

author: theplax
title: Freesound - Tram Doors Closing 2.wav by theplax
description: Tram doors closing with warning beep, Nottingham Nov 2021. Similar to previous recording but from other model of tram used on the network. Recorded using Voice Recorder Pro on a Samsung Galaxy S8 smartphone and edited in Adobe Audition.
